title: 🔥 THE TRUE GOSPEL OF PAUL – DID THE CATHOLIC CHURCH DISTORT HIS TEACHINGS?
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUE GOSPEL OF PAUL – DID THE CATHOLIC CHURCH DISTORT HIS TEACHINGS?
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’ve heard that Paul preached salvation by faith alone, but the Catholic Church teaches faith plus works. Did the Catholic Church twist Paul’s message?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The apostle Paul was handpicked by Jesus Christ Himself to preach the Gospel of grace to the Gentiles (Acts 9:15). He wrote most of the New Testament, making it clear that salvation is by faith alone, not by works!
🚨 BUT HERE'S THE SHOCKING TRUTH: Catholicism twists Paul’s message by adding human works, sacraments, and traditions to salvation—something Paul directly warned against!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

🚨 THE BIG QUESTION: WHO WILL YOU BELIEVE?
✔️ The inspired writings of Paul, chosen by Jesus Christ?
❌ Or a man-made religious system that contradicts Scripture?
🔥 THE TRUTH WILL SHOCK MANY! LET’S BREAK IT DOWN!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Paul’s Gospel or a man-made distortion?
WHO WAS PAUL? CHOSEN BY CHRIST TO PREACH GRACE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, who exactly was Paul, and why did Jesus choose him to preach the Gospel?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Before becoming an apostle, Paul was known as Saul of Tarsus—a zealous Pharisee who violently persecuted Christians. He was deeply religious, devoted to the Jewish Law, and saw Christianity as a dangerous heresy.
🚨 BUT THEN JESUS HIMSELF INTERVENED!

📖 Acts 9:3-6 (KJV)
"And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest."
🔥 FROM A MURDERER TO A MESSENGER – GOD’S GRACE TRANSFORMED PAUL!

1️⃣ PAUL'S RADICAL CONVERSION WAS A DIVINE MIRACLE!
✔️ Paul was blinded for three days after meeting Jesus (Acts 9:8-9).
✔️ He was later baptized and filled with the Holy Spirit (Acts 9:17-18).
✔️ Jesus personally revealed the Gospel of grace to him (Galatians 1:11-12).
✔️ Instead of persecuting Christians, Paul became their greatest teacher!

📖 1 Timothy 1:15-16 (KJV)
"Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief. Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting."
💡 LESSON: Paul’s story PROVES that God can use even the worst sinner for His glory!

2️⃣ JESUS GAVE PAUL A SPECIAL MISSION – TO PREACH GRACE TO THE GENTILES!
📖 Acts 9:15 (KJV)
"But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel."

🚀 PAUL WAS SENT TO PREACH:
✔️ That salvation is by faith alone, not by works (Ephesians 2:8-9).
✔️ That Gentiles can be saved without following Jewish laws (Galatians 3:28).
✔️ That righteousness comes from Jesus, not religion (Philippians 3:9).
✔️ That Christians must reject false gospels (Galatians 1:8-9).
🔥 PAUL PREACHED A PURE GOSPEL – BUT RELIGIOUS LEADERS HATED HIM FOR IT!
💡 QUESTION: If Jesus handpicked Paul to preach grace, why do religious leaders today reject his message?
🚨 NEXT: Let’s expose how Catholicism twists Paul’s clear message of salvation by faith alone!
HOW CATHOLICISM TWISTS PAUL’S MESSAGE OF SALVATION BY FAITH ALONE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if Paul preached salvation by grace through faith alone, why does the Catholic Church teach that works, sacraments, and obedience to the Church are required for salvation?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Catholic Church claims to follow Paul, yet they completely distort his message by adding human efforts, traditions, and religious rituals to salvation. But Paul’s writings directly oppose these false teachings!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

🚨 BUT CATHOLICISM SAYS:
❌ Baptism is required for salvation (Catechism of the Catholic Church, 1213).
❌ Confessing sins to a priest is necessary for forgiveness (CCC, 1456).
❌ Salvation is a process of faith + good works (CCC, 2027).
❌ Purgatory is needed to cleanse sins after death (CCC, 1030-1031).
❌ Mary is a co-mediator with Jesus (CCC, 969).
🔥 NONE OF THIS IS IN THE BIBLE! LET’S EXPOSE THESE LIES!

1️⃣ LIE: "FAITH ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH – YOU MUST DO GOOD WORKS TO BE SAVED!"
📖 Galatians 2:16 (KJV)
"Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ... for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 Good works are the RESULT of salvation, not the requirement for it (James 2:18).
👉 Abraham was justified by faith, not by works (Romans 4:2-3).
👉 Salvation is a FREE GIFT (Romans 6:23).
🚨 DANGER: Catholicism enslaves people with a "performance-based" salvation, making them trust the Church instead of Jesus!

2️⃣ LIE: "YOU MUST BE BAPTIZED TO BE SAVED!"
📖 1 Corinthians 1:17 (KJV)
"For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 Baptism is an act of obedience, NOT a requirement for salvation!
👉 The thief on the cross was saved without baptism (Luke 23:42-43).
👉 Salvation is by faith ALONE (John 3:16, Romans 10:9).
🚨 DANGER: The Catholic Church replaces the power of faith with rituals!

3️⃣ LIE: "YOU MUST CONFESS TO A PRIEST TO BE FORGIVEN!"
📖 1 John 1:9 (KJV)
"If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 Only Jesus has the power to forgive sins (Mark 2:7, 1 Timothy 2:5).
👉 No priest is needed—confess directly to God!
👉 Catholic confession is man-made, NOT biblical!
🚨 DANGER: Catholic priests act as "middlemen" between God and man, contradicting Scripture!

4️⃣ LIE: "PURGATORY CLEANS YOU FROM SINS AFTER DEATH!"
📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV)
"And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 There is NO second chance after death!
👉 Jesus’ blood cleanses ALL sins (1 John 1:7).
👉 The Catholic idea of purgatory is found nowhere in the Bible!
🚨 DANGER: Purgatory denies the sufficiency of Jesus’ sacrifice on the cross!

5️⃣ LIE: "MARY IS THE CO-MEDIATOR BETWEEN GOD AND MAN!"
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV)
"For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 Only Jesus is the mediator between God and man—NOT Mary!
👉 Mary called God her SAVIOR (Luke 1:47), proving she needed salvation!
👉 The Catholic Church elevates Mary above Christ, which is idolatry!
🚨 DANGER: Praying to Mary takes away glory from Jesus and is spiritual deception!
🔥 THE CATHOLIC CHURCH TWISTS PAUL’S TEACHINGS TO CONTROL PEOPLE!

📖 Galatians 1:8 (KJV)
"But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed."
💡 QUESTION: Will you trust Paul’s Gospel or a religious system that contradicts the Bible?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s issue the final challenge—Will you reject false religion and stand on God’s Word alone?

"Prove all things; hold fast that which is good."
Below are the Bible verses and historical sources that confirm that Paul’s Gospel was distorted by the Catholic Church, which replaced faith alone with human traditions!

"But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed."

"But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness."
💡 Lesson: Faith alone, NOT works, justifies a person before God!

"Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us."
💡 Lesson: Salvation is based on GOD’S MERCY, not religious deeds!
